description:
Third-party PlayStation Remote Play streaming client, formerly known as PSPlay.

PXPlay (formerly PSPlay) is a third-party PlayStation Remote Play streaming client for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It supports PlayStation 4 and 5 consoles with features including custom gamepad button mapping, advanced GPU-accelerated decoding with zero-copy D3D11 and Vulkan rendering, FSR 1.0 spatial upscaling up to 4K, HDR output support, and multi-language UI.
🚀📦 PXPlay Multi Platform Release

Android v9.0.0 • PC v3.1.1
PXPlay Android v9.0.0 is a major update introducing a dedicated modern Vulkan rendering pipeline, local multiplayer, video enhancement controls, new Home-screen features, major interface refinements and improved support for dual-screen devices.
PXPlay PC remains on v3.1.1 for Windows, Linux and macOS. The PC version has not changed with this release, and its existing release notes are preserved further below for reference.

📱 PXPlay Android v9.0.0
PXPlay Android v9.0.0 is a major update with important improvements to rendering, multiplayer, dual-screen support and the Home experience.

🎞️ A New Vulkan Rendering Pipeline
PXPlay now includes a dedicated modern Vulkan rendering pipeline on supported Android devices.
The new renderer is designed to provide a strong foundation for modern GPUs and future rendering improvements while retaining the established OpenGL renderer for compatibility.
Users can select the renderer that works best for their device.

✨ Video Enhancement Quality
A new Video Enhancement Quality setting is available for both the OpenGL and Vulkan renderers.
It allows users to choose the preferred balance between enhancement quality and GPU performance, making it easier to adapt PXPlay to anything from efficient mobile devices to powerful gaming handhelds and Android TV hardware. This builds on the existing FSR 1.0 video upscaling to further enhance stream quality, making PXPlay one of the highest-quality PlayStation Remote Play apps available on Android.

🎮 Local Multiplayer
PXPlay Android now supports local multiplayer for PS4 and PS5 Remote Play sessions.
Connect multiple compatible controllers and enjoy supported local multiplayer games together through a single PXPlay stream.

🏠 Recently Played Games
The Home view now includes a Recently Played Games section.
Recently played titles appear with their artwork and can be launched directly, making it faster to return to a game without first navigating through the console interface.

📌 Game Widgets
Individual games can now be added as widgets to the Android Home screen.
This allows a specific game to be launched directly from a widget, providing a quick path from the Android launcher to the selected console and game.

📱 Better Dual-Screen Support
On dual-screen handhelds like the AYN Thor, PXPlay can now show parts of the game picture on the second screen, such as the minimap, a health bar or an ammo counter.
Open the cutout editor from the stream and mark up to five areas. Each one appears live in its own box on the second screen. Save layouts for different games and switch between them.
Cutouts never hold up the stream. They need the OpenGL ES or Vulkan rendering engine.

🖥️ Interface Improvements
Version 9.0.0 includes numerous updates throughout the Android and Android TV interfaces:
- Improved Home view with recently played games.
- Direct game launching from recently played game cards.
- New game-specific Home-screen widgets.
- Better handling of dialogs, sheets and startup messages.
- Improved focus behavior and controller navigation on Android TV.
- Refined presentation across phones, tablets, foldables, gaming handhelds and TVs.
- Additional visual and usability improvements throughout the app.

🌍 Hebrew Translation
PXPlay is now available in Hebrew.
The new translation includes right-to-left interface support and extends PXPlay's language coverage to even more users.

📦 Updates for the Standalone APK
The standalone Android APK can now check for new versions and securely install updates directly from PXPlay.
- Automatic update checks are performed once per day.
- Updates can also be checked manually from the Info view.
- Users can choose between updating inside PXPlay or downloading the APK in a browser.
- Download progress is shown and downloads can be cancelled.
- The downloaded APK is verified before Android is allowed to install it.
- PXPlay checks the file, version, Android compatibility and signing certificate.
- Updates are never installed while a Remote Play stream is running.
- Android TV devices are fully supported.
- If Android closes PXPlay while granting installation permission, opening PXPlay again continues the update automatically.

🛠️ Additional Improvements
- Improved stream stability during Android configuration changes.
- Better handling of display density, language, layout direction, dark mode and related system changes.
- Improved second-display and cutout behavior.
- Improved game-widget launch handling.
- Improved startup prompt coordination so multiple dialogs do not overlap.
- General rendering, controller, interface and stability improvements.

📱 Previous Android Releases

Android v8.1.1
Android v8.1.1 was a focused maintenance update with general stability improvements and fixes for dual-screen, controller, artwork and rendering-related issues.
- Improved second-display detection so virtual displays, such as screen recording or casting surfaces, are ignored and the real monitor is selected.
- Fixed the DualSense touchpad click not working while a custom gamepad mapping was active.
- Fixed recently played game artwork and profile avatars getting stuck or not refreshing.
- Improved PSN account token handling and recovery from faulty tokens.
- Fixed a crash on some multi-monitor setups, for example on Samsung Galaxy S25 devices.
- Fixed the aspect-ratio button not showing on a second display.
- Fixed an image-upscaling EGL rendering issue.
- General bug fixes and stability improvements.

Android v8.1.0
Android v8.1.0 focused on general bug fixes, UI improvements and better support for modern Android device form factors.
- General bug fixes and improvements.
- UI improvements and refinements.
- Added support for dual-screen setups on Android devices, such as the AYN Thor.
- Additional stability improvements based on user feedback.

Android v8.0.2
- General bug fixes and improvements.

PXPlay Android v8.0.0 Major Features
Version 8.0.0 was a major Android milestone and introduced a completely redesigned modern interface together with many new features.

Redesigned Modern UI
- New modern Android UI.
- Redesigned Android TV experience.
- Improved layouts for phones, tablets and foldables.
- Dark mode support.
- Improved settings, onboarding and console management screens.
- Better visual consistency across the app.

Faster Console Setup
- Automatic remote registration without PIN where supported.
- Remote registration support without requiring the same local network in supported flows.
- Improved registered console cards.
- Optional Wake-Up button for registered consoles.
- Wake-Up support from Home-screen widgets.
- Auto Connect option when the app launches.

Streaming Improvements
- Compact stream-area mode for foldables, dual-screen and flip devices.
- Option to display the stream in the top part of the screen.
- More aspect-ratio and zoom modes.
- Optional aspect-ratio button during streaming.
- Toggleable performance overlay with live stream metrics.
- Configurable FSR sharpening.
- Separate Remote Play and Local Play connection behavior.
- Preferred default Remote Play mode: PSN or Manual IP.

Controller and Input Improvements
- New gamepad button-mapping UI.
- Easier remapping workflow.
- DualSense haptic intensity follows console settings.
- DualSense adaptive-trigger intensity follows console settings.
- DualSense lightbar colors are forwarded from the PlayStation.
- Optional on-screen display of forwarded lightbar colors.
- New gamepad refresh-rate setting including Ultra mode.
- Improved on-screen control customization.

Home Screen and Console Management
- New Android Home-screen widgets.
- Launch registered consoles directly from widgets.
- Wake-Up button available on widgets.
- Improved dashboard and console cards.
- Option to show only one registered console card per screen.
- Option to disable vertical background stripes.

Localization and Quality of Life
- More translation coverage.
- Improved onboarding flow.
- Better settings organization.
- General performance and stability refinements.

🖥️ PXPlay PC v3.1.1
The PC version is unchanged with this release.
PXPlay PC v3.1.1 remains available for Windows, Linux and macOS.
v3.1.1 is a focused maintenance release following v3.1.0. It concentrates on stability, compatibility and safer platform integration, including an important Vulkan fix for older Intel-based Macs, improved Linux and Steam Runtime support, more reliable Local Play console detection, stronger license handling and several startup, focus and demo-related fixes.

⏪ In Case You Missed v3.0.0
v3.0.0 was one of the biggest PXPlay PC updates so far and introduced:
- Local multiplayer for PS4 and PS5
- Frame generation and interpolation
- The new D3D12 renderer on Windows
- DualSense haptic feedback over Bluetooth
- Steam shortcuts that launch directly into a stream
- Remote console registration through PSN
- Direct game launching from recently played games
- Improved third-party launcher integration
- A modernized rendering and video enhancement pipeline
All of these features remain part of v3.1.1.
The full v3.0.0 release notes can be found here:
https://github.com/streamingdv/PSPlay-Application-Hosting/releases#release-v3.0.0_v8.1.1

🌟 What v3.1.0 Added
v3.1.0 built on that foundation with:
- Smoother and more consistent frame generation and frame pacing
- Improved rendering and decoder stability
- A further modernized interface with animated backgrounds
- Better DualSense haptics and motion controls
- More robust third-party launcher integration
- FFmpeg 8.1.3
- Numerous controller, focus and UI improvements
v3.1.1 keeps all of those improvements and focuses on making the overall experience more reliable across supported platforms.

🍎 Important macOS Stability Fixes

Fixed Vulkan Crashes on Older Intel-Based Macs
Fixed a native crash when initializing the Vulkan renderer on some older Intel-based Macs and legacy Mac GPUs.
